# Relax Sound — Requirements

> **Status: Proposed** (2026-11-06). Not built yet.

## Context

A pause blocks every app, so the user cannot open a music app to go with it
unless they left one among "Apps that stay". Some people want a quiet sound
under the pause, and want it to end by itself with the pause. The sound is
**generated by the app** (noise, rain, waves, a low drone): no audio files,
no network, no account, in line with the rest of the app.

## User Story 1: A sound under the pause

As the phone's user, I want to pick a soft sound before a pause, so the
pause has something calm under it.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN the user sets up a pause THEN the system SHALL offer a "Sound" choice:
   Off, Rain, Waves, Brown noise, Drone. The default SHALL be Off.
2. WHEN a pause starts with a sound chosen THEN the system SHALL start it and
   keep it going with the screen off and the app in the background.
3. WHEN the pause ends, for any reason (natural expiry, password, NFC, slow
   exit, boot restore finding no session) THEN the sound SHALL stop.
4. THE system SHALL remember the last choice, like the last duration, and
   scheduled pauses SHALL use the sound set on that schedule, Off if none.

## User Story 2: Control from the block screen

As the phone's user, I want to turn the sound off during the pause without
ending it, so I can have silence when I need it.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE block screen SHALL show a small sound toggle when a sound was chosen.
2. WHEN the user turns it off or on THEN the system SHALL stop or resume the
   sound, and the password SHALL NOT be asked: it loosens nothing.
3. THE toggle SHALL expose a name and a 48 dp touch area for TalkBack.

## User Story 3: A well-behaved sound

As the phone's user, I want the sound to give way to what matters.

### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE sound SHALL use the system media volume and request audio focus.
2. WHEN a call, an alarm or another app takes audio focus THEN the sound
   SHALL stop for as long as it is lost and resume if the focus returns.
3. WHEN headphones are unplugged THEN the sound SHALL pause.
4. WHEN "remove animations" is on THEN nothing changes: the sound has no
   visual component.

## Group pauses

1. In a time together, each phone SHALL choose its own sound; the choice does
   not travel in the recipe. See "Decisioni aperte".

## Out of scope

- Music files, the user's own tracks, streaming.
- Timers or fades beyond a short fade-in and fade-out of the sound.
- Anything in History, streaks or goals: the sound is not recorded.
